## Filling a machine one grid cannot

8 blocks of compute on 8 SMs holding one block each, cut into launches.
The work is the same in every row; only the number of queues changes.

| Launches | blocks each | one stream | n streams | speedup |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 8 | 90 | 90 | **1.00x** |
| 2 | 4 | 180 | 90 | **2.00x** |
| 4 | 2 | 360 | 90 | **4.00x** |
| 8 | 1 | 720 | 90 | **8.00x** |

## Covering one kernel's waiting with another

Two launches on one SM holding two blocks, in cycles. `memory` is 16 loads of a line each,
`compute` 16 fused multiply-adds. *hidden* is what concurrency took off the shorter of
the two, which is the most it could take.

| First | second | 1st alone | 2nd alone | one stream | two streams | hidden |
|---|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| compute | compute | 90 | 90 | 180 | 92 | **97.78%** |
| memory | memory | 6,490 | 6,490 | 12,980 | 6,492 | **99.97%** |
| memory | compute | 6,490 | 90 | 6,580 | 6,490 | **100.00%** |

## A grid the host never learns

A cull pass adds up 8 visibility flags and writes the total where the
launch after it reads its grid. `host` is that same grid launched the ordinary
way, for the cost of asking.

| Visible | grid | indirect work | cycles | host work | cycles |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 8 | 8 | 6,924 | 900 | 6,688 | 90 |
| 4 | 4 | 3,580 | 900 | 3,344 | 90 |
| 2 | 2 | 1,908 | 900 | 1,672 | 90 |
| 0 | 0 | 236 | 810 | 0 | 0 |
